channel.desc: The team help an Elvis Presley fan from Essex who says she was left in heartbreak hotel following a disappointing date with the 'King'. Can she get a refund? Also on the programme, the fake bailiffs threatening to seize the goods of small business owners. With the clock ticking, can the courts reveal the truth in time? And the identity theft that led to one woman's bank accounts being used for money laundering.
